sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety in a unified table; rank 1 was arXiv:2607.07461v1 after recent duplicate themes were excluded.
The main agent read the arXiv PDF, API metadata, and HTML text, extracting dataset, RQ, method, benchmark, metric, table, and limitation details.
SPELLSMITH was decomposed into risk profile R=<C,P,W>, metadata augmentation, invocation reflection, benchmark setup, and ablation results.
The article distinguishes mitigation from fix and calls out missing benign utility, model transfer, adaptive attack, dynamic metadata, and hard-isolation evidence.
Related MCP security lines were compared against malicious-server defenses, static scanners, ordinary jailbreak defenses, and recent UCM/STRACE coverage.
The Markdown uses TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formula blocks, pseudocode-style definitions, and Mermaid; no direct external image references were used.
